name: Multisite Evidence Consolidation and Scale Readiness
objective: Consolidate independently reviewed multisite evidence into a controlled portfolio view and determine whether the system is ready for governed scale, without collapsing site-level provenance or promoting readiness into product release.
fail_closed_conditions: site-level outcome overwritten by portfolio status
aggregation_rules: Aggregates must retain site membership and source provenance.
Forecast/model/proxy values remain their original classes.
Portfolio metrics cannot imply physical harvest where no empirical record exists.
Administrative node counts cannot be presented as installation or harvest counts.
A portfolio anchor proves integrity of the anchored package only.
scale_boundary: Scale readiness authorizes controlled continuation of the operating framework; it does not constitute product, potable-water, regulatory, commercial, premium-condition or environmental-performance release.
